name: @dsh-chamber/dsh-chamber-client-ui-open-in
description: Chamber-bundled open-in client plugin (designs 16/20 + Batch 3 unification): one header entry over the per-source view-model — the page-level machine catalog (installed apps and their real icons, read once from the local instance) plus the source's launch carrier (the machine host domain, or the desktop main-process VS Code provider for a remote SSH target). Since 2026-12 this package also hosts the conversation stream-health seat (design 14 §D4): the chamber's recovery arm for a journal the official stack latches into 'error' (stage-move re-open) and for a parked 'loading' open: the stall notice, the user's per-session rebuild control, and — since 2026-09-21 — an EVIDENCE-GATED automatic rebuild (the concrete open promise must report NO open in flight, so a slow Host is never interrupted) plus a 90 s hard-failure notice so the user is never left on a silent spinner
